external_collaboration.partner_name: The Institute for Performance and Learning (I4PL)
external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Grow Learn Connect was founded by IFC, a member of the World Bank Group, to support the sustainable growth of MSMEs in emerging markets through capacity building and skills development. IFC has partnered with some of the globe's most respected learning organizations, such as The Institute for Performance and Learning (I4PL) and The Learning and Performance Institute (LPI), to develop our Guide to Training and the IFC-LPI TPMA certification.

In this capacity, the Ministry is also responsible for the public finances and the preparation of the budget.
